title: MessageConsumerContribution
description: A code-declared inbound message handler: Spring Kafka `@KafkaListener`, Spring AMQP `@RabbitListener`, JMS `@JmsListener`, NATS subscriber, AWS SQS poller, NestJS `@MessagePattern`, etc. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (Rule 1): `SpringScanKS` (Kafka/AMQP today); future broker-specific KSs.

handlerSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the handler method/function. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

destinations.description: Topics / queues / subjects the consumer is bound to.

groupId.description: Consumer group / subscription name when applicable.

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Broker/framework-specific facts (e.g. Kafka `containerFactory`, AMQP exchange/routingKey, SQS visibility-timeout overrides).
